_about: Which 3D model goes on which footprint of the three TS06 boards, attached at render time to a scratch copy of the board (tools/models3d.py, tools/render_populated.py). The committed boards under PCB/ are not touched. Read the docstring of tools/models3d.py for the schema. kind: taken = a model file that already exists (the repo's own STEP, or a KiCad library model); made = drawn here in OpenSCAD (3d/populated/models/*.scad, output .wrl); board = the footprint's own (model) line.

IN12_tube.note: 3d/IN12.step (the repo's glass envelope, 19.47 x 28.86 x 25.5 plus pins). Its pins hang 4.66 mm below its seating plane, so with the plane 4.5 mm above the board face (case_pair.py IN12_SEAT, assumed there) the tips end 0.16 mm past the back face

IN12_contacts.note: 12 tube-socket contacts, 4.5 mm tall, on the footprint's pad ring (3d/populated/models/tube_pins.scad)

IN17_tube.note: 3d/IN17.step lies along x in its own frame: 24.3 mm of glass from the dome to the end of the stalk, then lead stubs (5.5 mm). Scaled along x (the tube's axis) by 0.811523 = 19.72 / 24.3, so the glass is the owner's measured 19.72 mm from the dome to the end of the glass (bench caliper, 2026-10-02; case_pair.py IN17_D) and the stubs 4.46 mm; the section (12.25 x 17.67) is the model's own and is not changed. Turned to stand on its stubs, the glass end 10.28 mm above the board face and the dome 30.0 (case_pair.py IN17_STANDOFF = Z_DISP_F - IN17_D: the face level with the IN-12s), centred on the 11-pad pattern

IN17_wires.note: wire leads D0.4 from the end of the model's scaled stubs (4.46 mm long, ending 5.82 mm above the board) to 0.8 mm past the back face

IN17_pip.note: the exhaust pip, D3.5 with a round tip, standing 4.0 mm out of the glass end between the leads (case_pair.py IN17_PIP: the owner's estimate of 2026-10-02, 'closer to 4 mm', not a caliper reading; the diameter is inferred)

INS1_lamp.note: 3d/INS1.step lies along x. Turned to stand on its 10 mm leads, centred on the lead pair, the tip 30.0 mm above the board face (the tube faces' plane, an inferred choice; no source states the colon lamps' height)

LED_3mm.note: 3 mm amber LED, 5.3 mm tall (footprint descr), flat on the cathode (pad 1) side

PLS5_header.note: KiCad's 1x05 male header: the PLS-5 the RTC module's own socket plugs onto

RTC_module.note: DS3231 mini module lying on its socket over the header

NANO_on_PBS15.note: Arduino Nano on two PBS-15 strips

JST_PH_SM.note: JST PH side-entry SMD header S6B-PH-SM4-TB

JST_PH_SM_UP.note: JST PH upright (top-entry) SMD header B6B-PH-SM4-TB, 13.9 x 5.0 x 6.0 (KiCad's library has the footprint but no model)

KMD1_button.note: 3d/KMD1.step (bushing 7.82, plunger 6.0, body 16.66 deep + 3.0 lugs), axis along x in its own frame. Turned to point out of the fascia's front, its shoulder on the fascia's back face, the body's long side (the lug plate) pointing up the fascia (-y), away from the landing pads

MT1_lever.note: 3d/MT1.step (bushing 7.82, body 16.66 deep + 3.0 lugs), axis along x in its own frame. Turned to point out of the fascia's front, its shoulder on the fascia's back face, the body's long side (the lug plate) pointing up the fascia (-y), away from the landing pads

SR25_rotary.note: 3d/SR25.step (body D25 x 11.3, bushing D8.62 x 7.0, shaft D6 x 13.0), axis already along z: its shoulder (z 13.3) put on the fascia's back face (offset z -13.3)
